about: Rollback floors (BETA-CLOUD-PLAN 5). A Cloud ref must equal or descend from every sha under floors (every group but `code` and `gatewayCode`), or the rollback-floor gate refuses it with that floor's reason. Read from the pipeline tree, never from the candidate. The `gatewayCode` group holds the gateway's floors as CODE commits (#1478 phase 2: the gateway image and stack are built from Code, so a Cloud sha cannot say what gateway source an image holds): the Code commit a gateway is built from must equal or descend from each, judged in the Code clone in the gateway step and by `rollback-plan` (only when the operator has a Code clone; otherwise a note). Each row names a Code commit that CONTAINS the change the Cloud commit its `gateway` row names made to the gateway files (every line that Cloud commit added is present in the Code commit's file, every line it removed is absent: tests/contract/pipeline-gateway-floor-containment.test.ts checks it with real git); the files are not all byte-identical: for the first pair 4 of 7 are identical and 3 are later versions that still carry the change. The `gateway` rows stay: they keep judging the Cloud ref, and a gateway image recorded before phase 2 was built from that Cloud ref. The `code` group is the exception: its shas are Code commits that a Code rollback target must equal or descend from (judged in the Code clone, only when a run rolls Code back); it holds the Code merge of BEDROCK-BYO-CHECK-FIXES (the controller names any further Code floor). A new floor is one reviewed edit here. Pending rows are NOT enforced: they name the condition after which the controller moves them into floors.
